dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.codexOtherMetricsComingSoon: Codex daily activity, model usage, and cost estimates are coming soon
dashboard.codexRateLimitExceeded: Codex rate limit exceeded — wait for reset or purchase credits
dashboard.usageErrorRateLimitedDetail: Another process (e.g. statusline) may be hitting the API
dashboard.usageErrorUnauthorized: Auth error: please log in to Claude Code again
dashboard.statusDanger: Will hit limit in {{time}} at this pace (resets in {{resetTime}} if idle)
dashboard.herdrUpdateCost: Applying it requires restarting the herdr server. All panes are re-created — agent conversations are restored automatically, but running commands are lost.
dashboard.herdrUpdateManualHint: herdr isn't managed by systemd/launchd here, so restart the herdr server manually to apply.
dashboard.opencodeNoRateLimitInfo: OpenCode does not expose rate-limit windows locally, so token totals are aggregated from its session store instead of showing cycle utilization. The cost is the figure OpenCode recorded for each turn, not an estimate of ours.
dashboard.grokNoRateLimitInfo: xAI does not expose rate-limit windows locally, so token totals are aggregated from Grok session logs instead of showing cycle utilization.
dashboard.kimiNoRateLimitInfo: Kimi Code does not expose rate-limit windows locally, so token totals are aggregated from Kimi session logs (sub-agent usage included) instead of showing cycle utilization.
dashboard.kimiDailyCostNote: Estimated from local token counts and the provider's list price, bucketed by your calendar day. {{total}} over the {{days}} days shown. OpenRouter's own billed figures are below.
dashboard.kimiDailyCostUnknown: {{date}}: cost unknown - the models used that day have no price here
dashboard.kimiDailyCostUnseen: {{count}} day(s) are blank because this server was not running while they could still be read.
dashboard.kimiDailyCostUnseenDay: {{date}}: not recorded - this server saw none of the week this day could be read in
dashboard.sttFallbackActive: The primary transcriber is unreachable — falling back to {{provider}} (billed)
dashboard.groqSttNote: Last 7 days: {{requests}} requests, {{audio}} of audio, {{cost}} estimated at list price. Recorded as transcriptions happen — Groq keeps no history this server can read back.
dashboard.groqSttCostUnknown: No list price for this model on this server, so no figure is shown.
dashboard.groqSttNoteNoCost: Last 7 days: {{requests}} requests, {{audio}} of audio. No list price for this model here, so no cost is shown. Recorded as each transcription happens - Groq keeps no history this server can read back.
dashboard.openRouterWindowNote: Billed figures from OpenRouter for the API key in your Kimi config, over OpenRouter's own calendar windows. The per-window amounts above are local estimates over rolling windows, so the two will not match exactly.

onboarding.resetConfirm: This will reset the tutorial and reload the page.
onboarding.step1Description: Control Claude Code sessions remotely. Access anytime from your tablet or smartphone.
onboarding.step2Description: Manage multiple Claude Code sessions simultaneously. Tap the menu button to view the session list.
onboarding.step3Description: Monitor usage limits, activity statistics, and cost estimates in real-time.
onboarding.step4Description: Review files modified by Claude Code. View diffs and previews to understand changes.
onboarding.step5Description: View the conversation history with Claude Code. Easily review past exchanges and context.
onboarding.step6Description: Tap the terminal to open the keyboard. Supports Japanese input and 📁 for image upload.
onboarding.step7Description: If the terminal display gets corrupted, tap this button to reset and fix the display.
onboarding.splitPaneDescription: Split the terminal vertically or horizontally to run multiple sessions side by side.
onboarding.sessionItemDescription: Tap to open the session. Long press to change color theme or delete. The status indicator shows if Claude is running.
onboarding.newSessionDescription: Create a new Claude Code session. Choose a working directory to start coding.
onboarding.historyTabDescription: Search and browse past Claude Code sessions. Resume previous conversations or view their history.
onboarding.dashboardTabDescription: Monitor usage limits, activity statistics, and cost estimates in real-time.
onboarding.welcomePrompt: Hello! Welcome to {{product}}. You are Claude Code, being accessed remotely through {{product}}. Please briefly introduce yourself.
onboarding.hookNotConfigured: Hook notifications aren't set up. Add {{bin}} notify to your Claude Code or Codex hooks to get OS notifications when a response finishes or an agent needs input. Session status (running / done / waiting) works without hooks.
